note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and Insider Gaming (both agree on every name, description and grade). Guide text is original, written for this entry, and cites its sources per trophy.

roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 5 and the finale. Twelve story trophies pop as you finish missions — none can be missed, so just enjoy the story and let them come.
roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.text: After the story, work the stranger mission strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final mission, Bret has a hunt, and eight strands together earn the silver.
roadmap.title: Strangers of Leonida

roadmap.text: Try all nine activity types, then chase the activity trophies: 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 14 Top Fun drone races, 20 race wins, beating Cal at fishing, and one arcade game.
roadmap.title: Activities

roadmap.text: Clear the map: 100 WAiNK scans, 3 collectible card sets, 100 vehicles discovered, 250 stunts, 50 challenges — and meditate at all 18 spots before you finish the story (the one trophy that may be missable).
roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration

roadmap.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck, hit the shops and a jewelry store, launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000, buy the garages and register 10 vehicles.
roadmap.title: Crime and money

roadmap.text: Finish the in-game 100% completion checklist (Progress > Stats after the story). A Long Road pops, and with it the platinum, Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.title: 100% and the platinum

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do. Follow this guide's roadmap in order and it pops right after A Long Road, the 100% completion gold.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the last one most players earn. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, and the 100% completion checklist appears. It is more forgiving than it sounds — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly (15 of the 18 card sets, 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of the 277 base vehicle models). What it does demand in full is every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and roughly 200 hours, and GameMapa notes most trophies come naturally on the way to 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission in Chapter 5. It pops automatically at the end of the campaign and cannot be missed. Once it does, free roam opens up and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida count: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. You do not need all 397 for this trophy, but 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250. The in-game checklist tracks your count, so check it before hunting the last few.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges, and every one needs a gold medal. Learn each range's target pattern first with a bronze run, then chase gold with the right weapon for the distance — rifles for long lanes, SMGs up close. This is widely rated one of the two hardest trophies alongside A Long Road, so leave it for a focused session rather than squeezing it between missions.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a strand with its own final-mission trophy, and Bret's hunt counts too — but PowerPyx notes not every side questline counts toward the eight, and the exact qualifying set was still being confirmed at launch. Work the named stranger strands first; the silver should pop as the eighth completes.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: There are 18 collectible card sets hidden around Leonida; complete any 3 of them. Cards are found in the world rather than bought, so sweep each area as you explore and use the WAiNK app's scans to spot points of interest you have not visited. You only need 3 sets, not all 18.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on your in-game phone and scan 100 spots: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Scan everything you pass while doing other things — the counter builds up fast if you make it a habit, and it doubles as a way to find collectible spots and map fog you have not cleared yet.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total — 100% completion needs all 8, so this trophy's five are a milestone on the way, not the end. Plan your escape route before you go in, and lose the wanted level before the game counts the job as done.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn — it pops automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play through the campaign; there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Like every chapter trophy, it pops on its own when the chapter's last mission ends — play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Automatic story progress, no missable step — the trophy is yours when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, so while you are here, start the vaults — you will need five for Maximum Withdrawal and eight for 100%.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop when the mission ends, so there is no separate task and no way to miss it — just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically as part of the campaign; finish the heist and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A mission-completion trophy: play the mission to its end and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Mission trophies cannot be missed — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission ends; keep an eye out for the airport's open runways, which matter again for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named mission trophies — finish the operation and it pops automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, all the way to his final mission. Stranger strands are found around Leonida after they open up in the story — follow the stranger marker, work through Andy's jobs in order, and the trophy pops at his last one. It also counts toward the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand through to his final mission. Kenton's strand is also tied to his treasure sets — GameMapa notes five of the seven sets feed the 100% checklist — so pick up his collectibles while you are working his missions.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand through to his final mission. Like the other stranger strands, it stays available after the story, so there is no rush — but each strand you finish brings Strangers & Freaks closer.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand through to his final mission. Work his jobs in order as they appear; the trophy pops at the end of the strand and counts toward the eight for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to his final mission. Five named stranger strands plus Bret's hunt and a few more make up the eight for the silver, so clear Tyrone's strand and keep going.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. Hunting is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None — take the hunt when Bret offers it and track the animal quietly rather than charging in.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, get a plane off the ground at VCIA without filing a flight plan. The exact trigger was still being confirmed by players at launch, but the description points at stealing a plane from the airport and taking off. Try it in free roam after the story, when the airport is open to you.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank — 'kinda hot in these Rhinos'. The working read is to get behind the wheel (or the cannon) of a Rhino tank; the exact trigger was still being confirmed at launch, and PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown. If you spot a Rhino at a military site, climb in and see what pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a drink and take it in. PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown, so players were still pinning down the exact spot at launch; the description itself is the best clue, and the beachfront bars are where to start.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: 'Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style' is a nod to the series' oldest trick: drive a car straight through a dealership's front window. PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown, so the exact showroom was still being confirmed at launch — pick a vehicle showroom, get a fast car, and go through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — 'follow-through' points at a proper delivery, so play a full game and aim for a strike rather than gutter balls. Bowling is one of the activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: 'A partnership with mass appeal' is deliberately vague, and this was one of the five hidden trophies still unsolved at launch — GameMapa notes PowerPyx lists its condition as unknown. The wording suggests a co-op or duo activity done well; watch for it while playing activities with your partner and check community findings as they land.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the running record of what your character does across Leonida. This is a grind trophy that fills up as you play: crimes, jobs, activities and choices all feed the profile, so it should pop naturally on the road to 100% without farming it directly.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests failing at something once and succeeding on the retry — most likely a stunt, heist step or challenge you have to attempt twice. This was one of the five hidden trophies still unsolved at launch, with PowerPyx listing the condition as unknown, so treat the description as the clue and watch community findings.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' reads like a trophy for stumbling into something strange — Leonida's oddities, easter eggs or a random event. It was one of the five hidden trophies still unsolved at launch, and PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown. Explore the map's odd corners, scan curiosities with WAiNK, and it will likely find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock the target down like a bowling pin. The name is a bowling joke: Ten Pin, as in ten pins. It was still being confirmed at launch, so line up a slow drive-by with a bat in hand and aim to send them flying.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, as PowerPyx lists them. You only need to try each one, not master it — one round of golf, one fishing challenge, one arcade game and so on. Do this early: it introduces you to every system the later trophies ask you to grind.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about smooth lines through the gates rather than raw speed — learn each course's gate order on a practice run, then race it for real. The locations are spread across Leonida, so this doubles as a tour of the map.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Mix street races, off-road and water events across Leonida, and use the fastest vehicle class for each. Race wins also feed the activity count for Master of None if you have not tried racing yet.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the bigger catch or the better haul before Cal does. Upgrade your rod and bait first, watch the tension meter, and reel steadily instead of yanking — snapped lines lose challenges.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any machine, any game, just see it through to the end. Arcades are scattered around Vice City; pick a short game for a quick pop, and remember this also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and PowerPyx flags this as the only trophy reported as possibly missable, because the very first meditation can be missed in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation, and complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 (KeenGamer's step-by-step agrees). Do all 18 spots as you find them, and never leave the Chapter 1 one for later — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges cover everything — driving, shooting, exploration, activities — so they fill up as you chase the other trophies. Check the challenge list under Progress regularly and pick off the easy ones (short drives, first-time actions) to reach 50 well before the endgame.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. GameMapa's tip: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easiest escape — police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It unlocks once you leave the red heat zone, so drive in, wait for the stars to fade, and drive out.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. GameMapa notes the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well — they are close together, so you can hit all three in one run. Keep the wanted level alive on purpose: do not hide or wait it out between shops, and drive straight from one to the next.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough to count a vehicle as discovered, according to GameMapa, so scan every new car, bike, boat and plane you see while exploring. Traffic in Vice City alone covers most of the list — the rare ones are found in the countryside and at the airport.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. GameMapa's tip: before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies in the open — a gang hangout or a wanted-level shootout — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the kills before it runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses calling it in, no cameras catching you. Late night helps — fewer people, slower responses — and a silenced approach beats a smash-and-grab for this one.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the heat. GameMapa notes this comes naturally on the way to 100%, since the checklist asks for more than the single truck this trophy needs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. Drive, fly and sail everywhere: the islands, the swamps, the farmland and the small towns, not just Vice City. The map screen shows which areas are still fogged, so use it as your checklist and mop up the corners last.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs its own off-the-books operations around Leonida — hit one per gang. These show up as you explore gang territory, and GameMapa notes the trophy comes naturally on the way to 100%, which asks for more than this trophy does.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies; your contacts wash them into clean cash over time. Keep the pipeline running — hand bills to contacts whenever you have them, and the total climbs while you do everything else.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. This counts cumulatively across every shop in the game — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so it fills up naturally if you buy gear as you play. If you are close near the end, a car mod or two will push it over the line.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings and give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect — buy them as your bank balance allows, and remember they also feed the vehicle collection for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. Photograph or log vehicles you find and add them to the app — ten registrations is a small number, so do it as you explore and it pops early.
trophies.name: On the Spot
